svg.title: Progressive Architecture Evolution: 1 User to 10M+ DAU
svg.desc: Architectural blueprint showing 9 scaling stages from a single server to multi-region cell-based and shuffle-sharded infrastructure, paired with Gunther's Universal Scalability Law retrograde curve.
svg.text: Scale From Zero to 10M+ Users: Progressive Architecture Blueprint
Each architectural layer is introduced strictly to relieve a measured bottleneck — premature distribution adds coherency tax before traffic justifies it.

g.text: • 10:1 read offload via async WAL stream
• CDN + Origin Shield absorbs static egress
Kafka / SQS / Outbox → Async Worker Fleets
• Bounded queues + DLQ isolate poison jobs
Hazard: Cross-region RTT & ISP DNS TTL
STAGE 8–9 · Horizontal DB Sharding, Telemetry, Cells & Shuffle Sharding (10M+ DAU)
App Pool + Cache + DB Shard A + Queue
App Pool + Cache + DB Shard B + Queue
Fault isolated — Cells A & B stay green
7x smaller outage at identical hardware cost
High-cardinality shard key + consistent hashing · Split celebrity hot keys · Avoid cross-shard JOINs
OTel traces + Prometheus histograms + SLO burn-rate alerts + GitOps canary + HPA hysteresis
Key Architectural Decision Gates Across the 0 → 10M Scaling Curve
• Working set fits in 512 GB–2 TB RAM
• CDN + Valkey cache cut DB reads 90%
• Write IOPS or WAL saturation on primary
